page_title: ARS 0-2 AST | Arsenal v Aston Villa 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90+6' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) was too forceful with his tackle and David Coote interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+5' Declan Rice (Arsenal) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.

90+4' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for David Raya to get hold of the ball.
90+2' He should have scored! Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
89' A cross from Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
87' Substitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko makes his way off the pitch and Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) comes on as his replacement.
87' 0 - 2 Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb inside the left post. What a beautiful shot.
86' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
84' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Lucas Digne sprays a pass out to Leon Bailey (Aston Villa), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
84' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

83' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
82' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will take a throw-in.
81' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
79' The game is interrupted now, Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) coming on for Nicolo Zaniolo.
79' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Gabriel Jesus will be replaced by Jorginho (Arsenal).
79' Substitution. Martin Odegaard walks off the pitch and Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) comes on as a substitute.
76' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
75' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
75' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
74' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
72' The foul by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) was seen by David Coote who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
72' The attendance is 60350.
70' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal).
69' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
68' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 17:9.
67' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Leandro Trossard is replaced by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).
67' That will be all from Ben White who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal).
65' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
65' John McGinn (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Aston Villa get a corner.

64' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Emiliano Martinez makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
63' John McGinn (Aston Villa) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
63' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) receives a yellow card.
62' It should have been a goal! Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
62' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

61' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Aston Villa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
61' Substitution. Moussa Diaby leaves the pitch and is replaced by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa).
60' Declan Rice (Arsenal) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
60' The resulting corner, taken by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), comes to nothing.
60' The ball is cleared after Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Corner kick. Arsenal will have an opportunity.
59' Referee David Coote sees the trip by Kai Havertz (Arsenal) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
56' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
55' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.

52' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
52' David Coote interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Declan Rice (Arsenal).
51' The resulting free kick from 20 metres out taken by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) was blocked by the defensive wall, which was perfectly positioned by the goalkeeper.
50' The players claim that Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Arsenal.
49' Wonderful movement by Arsenal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
48' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the right post!
45+4' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. David Coote blows his whistle for an infringement.
45+2' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' What was Gabriel (Arsenal) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' Gabriel (Arsenal) brings an opponent down and David Coote interrupts the game. Aston Villa win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
44' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
41' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.

40' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
39' POST! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
39' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), whose header floated just over the bar.
38' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
36' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Ben White (Arsenal) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
35' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
34' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
32' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
30' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
30' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
28' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
26' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

26' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play and Arsenal manage to earn a corner.
24' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
24' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
23' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Kai Havertz, but Emiliano Martinez displays great awareness to stop him.
22' David Coote blows his whistle and it's Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
21' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

20' What a miss! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
17' Bukayo Saka swings the cross over. Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
16' Lovely run from Kai Havertz (Arsenal). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
14' David Coote shows a yellow card to Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) for his blatant foul.
14' Flag goes up against Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
13' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.

12' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
9' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
8' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a throw-in.
7' Gabriel (Arsenal) trips an opposition player and David Coote signals a foul.
6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
5' David Raya displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
3' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
2' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) covers his face with hands! He produces a header from inside the box, but the ball floats just over the bar. What a chance that was to score from a rebound!
2' John McGinn (Aston Villa) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
1' The match has just started.
Aston Villa will kick the game off.
David Coote is the one to supervise the game today.
